★★★★★

This was my first cycling trip, and I was depending on Cigala Tours to make it a good one. They did not disappoint. Matteo, Marine and company were fantastic, putting together a great itinerary and making sure that everyone had a wonderful time. And if you haven’t been to Lake Garda, you have to go; it’s beautiful.

SteveCanada · Lake Garda
★★★★★

Had a wonderful tour with Cigala in the French Alps in June 2025. I just showed up ready to pedal and they took care of the rest: excellent rental bikes, phenomenal routes with stunning views, gracious accommodations and delicious food with local charm. As an added bonus, Matteo captures the action with amazing photos.

HankUSA · French Alps
★★★★★

The riding was spectacular, the scenery was out of this world, the food was amazing and everything ran so smoothly that all we had to do was enjoy ourselves. You can tell this isn’t just a business for them, it’s something they genuinely love.

WilliamIreland · Italy
★★★★★

Very well organised from the very first contact. Marine or Matteo rode with us each day and captured the best moments with hundreds of photos. A special thanks to Alessio, the driver of the support vehicle and bike mechanic.

A perfect blend of epic cycling alongside enjoying the best of Italian cuisine and culture. Tapping into Team Cigala knowledge and support maximises the fun and is great value. I’ll be back for more.
